investmentPlans.title: My investments
investmentPlans.subtitle: Keep advisor ideas in Planned until you buy, then track them in Owned.
investmentPlans.educationalNotice: Planned investments do not affect your totals or profit and loss. Only purchases you record appear under Owned. This app never buys or sells anything for you.

planned.title: Planned investments
planned.subtitle: Saved from the advisor and waiting for you to buy.
planned.empty: No planned investments. Save a plan from the advisor when you want to keep one.

card.movedCount_one: {{count}} purchase from this plan is now under Owned.
card.movedCount_other: {{count}} purchases from this plan are now under Owned.

edit.title: Edit {{investment}} plan
edit.notice: Change the planned amount, quantity, or reference price. An edited price is labelled user-supplied. These changes update the plan only and do not buy anything.

form.amountError: Planned amount must be greater than zero.
form.quantityError: Planned quantity must be greater than zero.
form.exceedsAmount: Quantity × price cannot exceed the planned amount.
form.priceError: Reference price must be greater than zero.

purchase.title: I bought {{investment}}
purchase.notice: Enter what you actually bought. Your real quantity and price can be different from the plan.
purchase.mergeNotice: You already own this investment. This purchase will be added and your average price will be recalculated.

form.quantityError: Quantity must be greater than zero.
form.priceError: Price must be greater than zero.

holdings.title: Owned investments
holdings.autoRefresh: Track purchases you recorded. Prices refresh every minute while this page is open.
holdings.emptyText: When you buy a planned investment, use “I bought this.” You can also add a purchase manually.
holdings.pricingDisabled: Live pricing is off. You can still add and edit purchases; current values will appear when pricing is enabled.
holdings.partialPrices: Prices are available for {{priced}} of {{total}} investments. Total current value and profit or loss stay hidden until every price is available.

calculation.cost: What I paid = Quantity × Average price + Fees
calculation.value: Current value = Quantity × Latest available price
calculation.return: Estimated profit or loss = Current value − What I paid. Selling costs and taxes are not included.

summary.currentValue: What my investments are worth now

holdings.deleteMessage: {{instrument}} will be removed from tracking. This does not sell or affect any real investment.

form.manualNotice: Enter an investment you already bought. This saves your information only; it does not buy or sell anything.
form.quantityHint: Enter the total you currently own.
form.quantityError: Quantity must be greater than zero.
form.averagePriceHint: For several purchases, use the weighted average price you paid.
form.priceError: Average price must be greater than zero.

confirm.deleteMessage: The remaining planned items will be removed. Any purchases already moved to Owned will stay there.
confirm.removeItemMessage: {{investment}} will be removed from this plan. This does not affect anything under Owned.

dashboard.title: Next planned investments
dashboard.empty: Save an advisor plan to keep your next investment ideas here.
